newsitem.title: INDIA: Falling world markets see Indian gold slide.
newsitem.headline: Falling world markets see Indian gold slide.

text.p: Falling international gold prices prompted a slide in Indian gold prices in early trade on Thursday while silver held steady, dealers said.
"Demand resistance capped a rally while reports of a fresh fall in world markets triggered unloading by the stockists," one dealer said. Gold was up by 10 rupees on Wednesday.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) fell by 150 rupees at 59,750 rupees in the early trade.
Silver prices was steady. "Industrial demand was low but shortage of ready silver kept market steady," one dealer said.
Silver was up by 25 rupees per kg on Wednesday.
